sections.kicker: Prepared for Tuetal by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Tuetal says it sits in the Catskills. The first photo says somewhere else.
sections.keep: The hand-drawn hand on the Obsidian box and the wordmark with its dots. They look made by someone, not by a template.

pins.quote: Our workshop sits high in the Catskill Mountains.
pins.what: The words put the workshop high in the Catskill Mountains. The hero photo shows cliffs above a blue sea.
pins.why: Place is the whole story here, and the first picture belongs to another coast.
pins.how: Show the Catskills first, the way you would show a visitor around.
pins.label: Your hero
pins.cost: The reader meets the story and the picture of it in two different places.

pins.area: The soap boxes are named Meteor Shower, Selenite, Obsidian and Boheme
pins.what: The boxes are named Meteor Shower, Selenite, Obsidian and Boheme. The text talks about plants and land.
pins.why: The names point to stone and sky. The story points to plants. A reader cannot tell which world is Tuetal.
pins.how: Choose the world and let the names and the words both follow it.
pins.label: Your names
pins.cost: Your products and your story pull in different directions.

pins.quote: making botanical soap, skincare, and scent by hand from the land around us
pins.what: By hand from the land around us is the line nobody else can say.
pins.why: No large brand can write it. It sits in body text under the photo.
pins.how: Move the line up and let it be the first thing the page says.
pins.label: Your story
pins.cost: The thing that makes you different reads as small print.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Tuetal's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Aesop, from another category. It lets place and product speak, and never raises its voice.
